observations: Blue plastic barrel/drum with red screw-cap lid, photographed outdoors on bare ground among other (dark-colored) drums.
Embossed text on the drum body reads '210' and '10.2Kg' (photo 0 and photo 1), consistent with a 210-litre capacity marking and empty weight.
Semi-transparent watermarks 'STAN HARMLESS RESOURCES' and 'FRANKTECH GLOBAL SERVICES' are overlaid on both photos; these are reseller/watermark text, not a manufacturer brand on the item itself.
No visible cracks, dents, or discoloration on the visible side of the drum; bottom and interior are not shown.
Lid is a screw-type red cap; seal condition cannot be judged from stills.
Background shows a mix of used barrels suggesting a scrapyard/reseller yard, implying these are reconditioned/second-hand industrial drums.

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Photos show an empty-looking drum with lid on; no interior shot or proof of prior contents is visible.
Embossed '210' is visible in both photos but partially obscured by watermark text; full number/unit not fully legible.

risks.risk: Drum may have previously held chemicals or non-food substances, making it unsafe for drinking water storage.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any hazard/chemical labels, or a video showing the interior and any residue/smell description from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade/industrial-reuse drum, not certified for potable water

risks.risk: Lid/gasket may not seal properly, allowing leaks or contamination.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or short clip of the cap being opened and closed, showing an intact gasket.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a non-sealing or uncertain lid

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or holes on the unseen side/bottom of the drum.
risks.proof: Additional photos from the opposite side and underside of the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, worst case

risks.risk: True capacity may differ from embossed '210' if figure is misread due to watermark overlay.
risks.proof: A clearer, unwatermarked close-up of the embossed capacity marking.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lower end of typical drum sizes (e.g., treated as ~200L rather than confirmed 210L)

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed close-up of the embossed capacity number on the drum body.
Photo or video of the interior of the drum (lid removed) showing cleanliness and absence of residue.
Photos of the opposite side and bottom of the drum for damage check.
Short video of the lid/cap being sealed to confirm gasket condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used plastic water drum of roughly 210L, but prior contents, seal integrity, and unseen-side condition are unverified, so it must be priced at the worst-case condition for a generic reused industrial drum pending further proof.
